# getstream Provider

Manage GetStream.io application configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials can be supplied three ways (first non-empty wins):
#   1. Provider attributes below.
#   2. Provider env fallback: STREAM_API_KEY / STREAM_API_SECRET (GetStream's
#      documented names; STREAM_KEY / STREAM_SECRET from the Go SDK also work).
#      With these set, a bare `provider "getstream" {}` block is enough.
#   3. Terraform input variables via TF_VAR_ (as shown here): export
#      TF_VAR_getstream_api_key / TF_VAR_getstream_api_secret.
variable "getstream_api_key" {
  type    = string
  default = null
}

variable "getstream_api_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = null
}

provider "getstream" {
  api_key    = var.getstream_api_key
  api_secret = var.getstream_api_secret

  # Optional wrong-app guard: fail fast if these credentials do not resolve to
  # an app with this name (e.g. a prod key pasted into a non-prod config).
  # May also be set via STREAM_APP_NAME.
  app_name = "linguado-dev"

  # Optional, for documentation/cross-reference only (not verified).
  # May also be set via STREAM_APP_ID.
  app_id = "1699146"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String) GetStream.io API key. May also be set via the `STREAM_API_KEY` or `STREAM_KEY` environment variable.
- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive) GetStream.io API secret. May also be set via the `STREAM_API_SECRET` or `STREAM_SECRET` environment variable.
- `app_id` (String) Numeric GetStream.io app ID, accepted for documentation and cross-reference in configuration. The app-scoped API does not expose the app ID, so this value is not verified against the credentials and is not persisted to state. Prefer `app_name` for the wrong-app guard. May also be set via the `STREAM_APP_ID` environment variable.
- `app_name` (String) Expected name of the GetStream.io app these credentials target. When set, the provider verifies the app the credentials resolve to has this name and fails otherwise. This guards against pointing an environment's Terraform at the wrong app (e.g. a prod key in a non-prod config). May also be set via the `STREAM_APP_NAME` environment variable.
